_comentario: Tanda 2 de arte (2026-10-31): retratos a rehacer tras la revisión humana, sus tokens, los tiles de muebles móviles de los planos (MAPS_SPEC §3) y la portada. Se usa ENCIMA de arte.config.json con `node tools/generar-arte.mjs --config tools/arte.tanda2.json …` (lo lanza tanda2.sh). Los assets con el mismo id+estilo que uno de arte.config.json lo reemplazan sólo mientras se usa --config. Elegidas las semillas, pasar los retratos y tokens a arte.config.json (prompt en vez de fuente doc15, `semilla` = la elegida) y los tiles/portada como assets nuevos. Generado por un script: los tamaños de generación salen de `metros` (~1 MP, múltiplos de 16, a lo sumo 3:1).

tile-nuevo._comentario: Como `tile`, pero para muebles de lugares limpios y caros (la Galería, la Torre Halloway, Gale Sentinel, Northline): sin el «worn, dusty and lived-in» del sufijo de base. Mismo flujo y recorte. Con `esquema`, usa `prefijo_esquema` (ver estilos.tile en arte.config.json).
tile-nuevo.prefijo:
Flat-lay overhead shot, camera pointing STRAIGHT DOWN at the floor from directly above, like a satellite or a floor-plan view: we see ONLY the top of the object, as a flat 2D shape; legs, castors and side faces are hidden underneath it and NOT visible. Top-down tile artwork of ONE single loose piece of furniture or prop for a virtual tabletop battlemap set in a modern, expensive building in present-day Seattle. The object is centred and fills about 85% of the frame. If the object is elongated, its long axis runs horizontally from left to right; if it has a backrest, the backrest runs along the top edge. Only the object described below, nothing else.

SUBJECT:
tile-nuevo.prefijo_esquema:
Top-down orthographic illustration of ONE single loose object seen from DIRECTLY ABOVE, like a floor plan, painted exactly over the line drawing so that every line of the drawing is an edge or a seam of the object. We only see its upper surfaces: no side faces, no legs, no perspective, no tilt, no horizon. A clean, expensive piece from a modern building in present-day Seattle. Nothing else around it or behind it.

SUBJECT, seen from above:
tile-nuevo.sufijo:
STYLE: illustrated photorealism with crisp, confident dark ink outlines under realistic painted materials, cold desaturated palette of rainy Seattle (wet slate grey, harbour blue, deep black), clean, well kept and expensive-looking, matching the battlemaps of the same chronicle.

BACKGROUND: a perfectly flat, uniform, plain light-grey background with nothing on it: no floor, no rug, no texture, no gradient, NO shadow cast on the ground, no vignette.

LIGHT: neutral even top light. NEVER a lit lamp, glow, halo, light pool or glowing screen.

ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT: no letters, labels, logos, numbers or legible print on boxes, papers or screens. No people, no hands, no frame, no border, no second object.

tile-vehiculo._comentario: Vehículos como tile (autos del ferry, camionetas, lancha): cenital de dron, mojados, sin texto ni chapas legibles. La orientación (frente a la derecha o abajo) va en el sujeto, porque los planos no la usan igual (ver nota de cada asset).
tile-vehiculo.prefijo:
Top-down tile artwork of ONE single vehicle for a virtual tabletop battlemap set in present-day Seattle, seen from DIRECTLY ABOVE as if photographed from a drone: a strictly orthographic top view like a satellite photo, only the roof, the bonnet, the windscreen and the boot or cargo bed are visible; no side panels, no wheels sticking out, no perspective, no isometric tilt. The vehicle is centred and fills about 90% of the frame along its length.

SUBJECT:
tile-vehiculo.sufijo:
STYLE: illustrated photorealism with crisp, confident dark ink outlines under realistic painted materials, cold desaturated palette of rainy Seattle (wet slate grey, harbour blue, deep black), matching the battlemaps of the same chronicle. The bodywork is wet with rain: beads of water and cold reflections on the roof and bonnet.

BACKGROUND: a perfectly flat, uniform, plain light-grey background with nothing on it: no road, no ground, no texture, no gradient, NO shadow cast on the ground, no vignette.

LIGHT: neutral even top light. Headlights and tail lights OFF: no glow, no halo, no light beams.

ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT: blank licence plates, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no brand emblems, no model badges. Nobody inside, no people, no frame, no border, no second vehicle.

assets.prompt: Helen Ward, a 34-year-old woman with a tired, sharp, intelligent face, faint shadows under her eyes, no make-up, dark wavy hair escaping a grey hood. A worn grey hoodie, plain clear reading glasses pushed up on top of her head. She sits indoors on the bare wooden floor of her small cluttered apartment, her back against a wall covered edge to edge in printed city street maps stuck with red, blue and yellow push pins; the maps are only abstract street grids, rivers and coastlines, with no labels, no street names, no legend boxes and no words at all. Her right hand holds a lit cigarette near her lips, with exactly five fingers. Her left hand rests on her knee holding a small, old, black plastic clamshell flip phone, FOLDED SHUT: a closed folding phone with a visible hinge and no screen showing; definitely NOT a smartphone, NOT a touchscreen, nothing glowing in her hands. A rain-streaked window beside her lets in the orange glow of a streetlight. Crimson accent: the red pins on the maps.
assets.nota: Helen Ward, 34 (content/pnjs/fuera.json: edad 34). Defecto: tenía un smartphone con la pantalla encendida y estaba en la calle; el doc 15 y la ficha piden el viejo móvil DE TAPA que le dio David (SAFE, DOC-05), en el piso de su departamento. Se pide la tapa cerrada sobre la rodilla (la mano no tiene que agarrarlo), adentro, y mapas sin rótulos.

assets.prompt: Charles Halloway, a slim Ventrue vampire of medium height who looks about FORTY years old, clearly middle-aged and not young: a mature, composed, unsmiling face with fine lines across the forehead and at the corners of the eyes, faint creases from nose to mouth, slightly hollow cheeks, very pale skin. Black hair with a neat old-fashioned side part, combed flat, a hairline slightly receding at the temples. Tired brown eyes. He stands perfectly still with both hands clasped behind his back, out of sight. A dark classic charcoal suit of conservative cut, a white shirt and a thin dark tie. He stands before a floor-to-ceiling window high above a night harbour with cranes and ferries, the wet city small far below him. Crimson accent: the reflection of a red aircraft warning light on the glass, over his heart.
assets.nota: Charles Halloway, Abrazado en 1958 a los 37 (nació en 1921); la ficha dice «aparenta unos cuarenta». Defecto: parecía de treinta. Se pide la edad explícita con marcas de la edad, y las manos detrás de la espalda como dice el doc 15 (en la versión anterior las tenía adelante).

assets.prompt: Preston Gale, a 53-year-old tech CEO, visibly in his fifties: a receding hairline, short hair greying at the temples and slicked back, deep crow's feet, heavy nasolabial folds, slightly loose skin under the jaw, a thickening middle-aged neck and waist. Deeply tanned, with a too-bright investor smile showing very white teeth and a sheen of sweat at his temples. An expensive navy suit with an open-collared white shirt and no tie. He stands indoors, dry, in a cold corporate lobby of glass and grey stone beneath a giant wall screen showing a mosaic of hundreds of small live doorbell-camera feeds: grainy night views of porches, front doors and driveways, with no text, no numbers, no timestamps and no interface on them. Crimson accent: a few of the small feeds tinted deep red.
assets.nota: Preston Gale, «cincuenta y pocos» (PNJ-19.md, fuera.json). Defecto: parecía de cuarenta. Se pide 53 con canas, entradas, patas de gallo y papada; adentro y seco (estaba bajo la lluvia), y el acento carmesí sin números (el doc 15 pedía «tiny numbers glowing red»: pseudo-texto).

assets.prompt: August Krell, a lean, hard man who looks about twenty-eight years old but holds himself like someone much older: a shaved head, an old knife scar running through his left eyebrow, a badly healed broken nose, a still, watchful stare. A long grey wool coat clearly cut for broader shoulders, hanging too big on him, over dark work clothes. He stands in a fighter's guard, side-on: his LEFT forearm is raised in front of his chest and his left hand is a single tight fist at chin height, seen from the side, drawn with correct anatomy: four fingers curled tightly into the palm, the thumb folded OUTSIDE across the middle of the fingers, scarred swollen knuckles, a normal wrist. His right arm hangs down relaxed at his side, the right hand hidden inside the long coat sleeve. He stands on a wet concrete dock between shipping containers at night. Crimson accent: a red shipping container behind him.
assets.nota: August Krell, aparenta 28 (Abrazado en 1972, nacido en 1944; PNJ-12.md). Zurdo. Defecto: la mano de la guardia salió deforme. Se describe UN solo puño con la anatomía explícita (cuatro dedos cerrados, el pulgar por fuera sobre los dedos), de perfil a tres cuartos, y la otra mano escondida en la manga del abrigo.

assets.prompt: Rosa Iturbe, a short, compact Basque woman who looks about thirty, with a square, stubborn jaw and a direct stare. Short black hair, cut practically. Small pale healed burn scars dotting her forearms from years of welding: old scars, not wounds, no blood. Grease-stained hands resting flat on a bar counter made from the split wooden hull of an old boat. Faded blue work overalls with the sleeves rolled up and a plain chest pocket, steel-toed boots. Indoors, in a dim dockside bar at night. On the wall behind her hang old black-and-white photographs of crowds of shipyard workers on strike, with no banners and no signs. The only sign in the bar is a red neon tube bent into the simple outline of a ship's anchor: there are NO letters, NO words and NO numbers anywhere in the image. Crimson accent: the red neon anchor.
assets.nota: Rosa Iturbe, aparenta unos 30 (Abrazada en 1991, nacida en 1961; PNJ-11.md). Defecto: el neón de atrás tenía letras («OT»). El doc 15 pedía «a red neon sign with one letter missing», que es texto por definición: se cambia por un neón rojo con forma de ancla, sin letras. También se quita el nombre bordado del mono (texto) y las quemaduras se piden como cicatrices viejas (en la anterior parecían heridas con sangre).
